title: bedpostx_gpu
description: Probabilistic tractography and diffusion MRI fitting tool

subject_dir.description: Directory containing the subject's DWI data and associated files (bvals, bvecs, data, nodif_brain_mask).
subject_dir.title: Subject Directory

gpu_queue.description: Name of the GPU(s) queue. Default: --coprocessor=cuda to let fsl_sub decide on the queue
gpu_queue.title: GPU Queue

num_jobs.description: Number of jobs to queue. The data is divided into this number of parts, useful for a GPU cluster. Default: 4
num_jobs.title: Number of Jobs

num_fibers.description: Number of fibres per voxel. Default: 3
num_fibers.title: Number of Fibers

ard_weight.description: Automatic Relevance Determination (ARD) weight. More weight means fewer secondary fibres per voxel. Default: 1
ard_weight.title: ARD Weight

deconv_model.description: Deconvolution model. 1: with sticks, 2: with sticks with a range of diffusivities (default), 3: with zeppelins
deconv_model.title: Deconvolution Model
